name: Razor's Shield (Assamite Sorcery (Awakening of the Steel), Intermediate)

system.description: Your sword interposes itself between you and attacks from afar, allowing you to parry ranged solid projectiles. For this turn and the next three turns, you may use your Melee Ability Traits to retest in challenges where you are subject to ranged attacks involving solid projectiles (thrown objects, arrows, bullets); you must be able to see the projectile coming, and bullets require Heightened Senses or a comparable power. Razor's Shield does not work against attacks that are not solid projectiles, such as flame, lightning, or spat blood. You must have a total number of Ability Traits in Melee and Crafts: Blacksmith equal to your level of mastery in this path.
